scope: Independent read-only review of Storybook IndexedDB storage/backup helpers and focused storage/backup tests. Studio integration is excluded. No tests, browser, build, deployment, install, or providers were used.

historicalFindings.finding: The prior source ignored onblocked, leaving the fake blocked-open test pending. The current source settles unavailable, clears the cached promise, and closes any late successful connection.

limitations.finding: The IDB profile deletion can commit and return true while its best-effort localStorage mirror update fails. If this removed the last IDB profile, the next compatibility `getChildProfiles()` call treats the empty store as first-run migration and recreates the stale profile from `amari_storybook_profiles_v1`. The new availability-aware inventory getter avoids that fallback when used; consider a durable migration-complete/tombstone marker so compatibility reads cannot resurrect an explicitly deleted profile after mirror failure.

reviewedBehaviors: Writes settle on transaction completion/abort rather than request success; open failures invalidate the cached promise and versionchange closes/reopens the connection; v1 upgrade creates only missing stores; inventory APIs distinguish readable-empty from unavailable; profile/series saves return commit status and preserve unknown metadata; restore validates required custom-book assets before mutation, adds nonduplicate ids with books/assets in one transaction, and aborts as a unit; backup round-trip retains unknown progress metadata while filtering unsafe prototype keys.
acceptanceBoundary: Source and test-definition review only. No test run or native IndexedDB proof was performed.

reviewDeltas.scope: Recheck of blocked-open settlement and the focused blocked-retry test after a concurrent source update.
reviewDeltas.resolution: Resolved in the current source: the first blocked event rejects the cached open attempt so inventory reports unavailable; the cache is cleared for a subsequent open; if the original request later succeeds, its late database connection is closed. This matches the fake's blocked-then-retry sequence.
reviewDeltas.blockedStatusLimitation: Inventory callers receive the generic unavailable result; the API does not distinguish a blocked upgrade from other open failures or expose progress.
reviewDeltas.acceptanceBoundary: Source-only recheck; no tests or native IndexedDB run.
